name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides loans at low rates of interest to small business units and individuals to enable them to set up or expand business in manufacturing, trading, and service sectors. MUDRA offers three types of loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), and Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh).

custom_criteria.business_type: Small businesses in manufacturing, trading, or services
custom_criteria.existing_loan: Should not have defaulted on previous loans

benefits.description: Collateral-free loans for small businesses. Three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001-₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5-10 lakh). Interest rates typically 8-12% per annum. Repayment period: 3-7 years

documents_required.name: Address Proof
documents_required.description: Utility bill, rent agreement, or passport

documents_required.name: Business Registration
documents_required.description: For existing businesses - GST/Shop Act registration

steps: Visit MUDRA portal or nearest bank/NBFC
Download and fill MUDRA loan application form
Attach required documents and business plan
Bank will verify documents and assess business viability
Loan sanctioned and disbursed to bank account
Start EMI repayment as per schedule

success_stories: Over 38 crore loans sanctioned worth ₹20 lakh crore since 2015
